data.name: BALL BOY Simulator
data.detailed_description:
BALL BOY Simulator

BALL BOY Simulator is a first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club.

Story

After every practice, the baseball team has a daily routine of counting all the baseballs used that day.

One day, several balls are found to be missing.

Fearing the coach's anger, the upperclassmen order the protagonist to search for them.

Unable to answer with anything but "Yes," the protagonist endures the watchful eyes of the coach and the unreasonable hierarchy of the team while searching the school grounds for the missing baseballs.

Psychological Horror

This game portrays the oppression and unreasonable treatment experienced in high school baseball clubs, based on the real-life experiences of the developer and those around them.

Whether you consider it horror is entirely up to you.

Streaming & Content Creation

You are welcome to stream or upload videos of any part of the game.

If possible, please include a link to the Steam Store page in your video description.

Monetization, memberships, and all other forms of revenue generation are fully permitted.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact the developer via X (formerly Twitter) or email.

Features

  • Explore the school grounds from a first-person perspective in search of missing baseballs.

  • Multiple stages set around the baseball field, school buildings, and club facilities.

  • Carry extra baseballs you collect over to the next stage.

  • A story depicting the harsh hierarchy and oppressive atmosphere of Japanese high school baseball clubs, inspired by real experiences.

Content Warning

This game contains depictions of violence and psychological oppression.
